title: Safe fetch: no IPv6 way around the private-address check
steps: Nothing changes on screen: link cards and extensions' fetches work as before. Open Link embeds tour and check its cards still draw.
In the console: fetch("/api/extensions/catalog?url=" + encodeURIComponent("http://[::ffff:127.0.0.1]/catalog/index.json")).then(r => r.json()) answers "Private and local addresses can't be fetched".
